beats.say: Why does AI keep saying delve?
Researchers scanned fifteen million medical paper abstracts.
In 2024, the word delves showed up twenty eight times more often than expected.

beats.say: So where did it come from?

beats.sub: humans rate answers, the AI copies the winners
beats.say: Chatbots are trained by humans who rate which answers sound best.
One popular theory: many raters used delve in everyday business English. So the AI learned, delve sounds smart.
